executiveSummary: During the November 2026 monthly monitoring cycle, we reviewed App and Dashboard server performance, performed build cache maintenance on both environments, and reviewed operational metrics for the past 30 days. We audited Craft (v16.1.0), which is currently active on this store. We also completed end-to-end read-only testing of the Custom Admin Dashboard. The development team added a Resend Email option for failed emails in the Email Logs module.

themeUpdateLog.summary: Shopify released a free theme update from v16.0.0 to v16.1.0. We audited Craft (v16.1.0), which is currently active on this store.
themeUpdateLog.testedNote: Craft (v16.1.0) is the theme tested this cycle. All other themes in the update list are pending.

app.label: App Server
assessment: The App server recorded a response time of 9 ms in the provided monitoring data.
No application errors were reported in the provided monitoring findings.

dashboard.label: Dashboard Server
assessment: The Dashboard server recorded a response time of 1 second in the provided monitoring data.

performanceMetrics.conclusion: Both environments showed low memory utilization and throughput below 1 RPS. The App server response time was 9 ms, while the Dashboard server response time was 1 second. Dashboard response time should continue to be monitored during future checks.

sslSecurity.coverageNote: Read live from the dashboard host during this audit run (not from the dev team text). The wildcard certificate covers the herokuapp.com domain.

findings: Reviewed the build cache status for both App and Dashboard environments.

buildCacheAnalysis.conclusion: Build cache maintenance was performed for both environments, with no issues reported during verification.

last24HoursUsage.title: Last 30 Days Usage
findings: Reviewed the provided App and Dashboard performance screenshots covering the past 30 days.
The App server recorded a response time of 9 ms.
The Dashboard server recorded a response time of 1 second.
Throughput was below 1 RPS for both environments.
App memory utilization was 17%, while Dashboard memory utilization was 15%.
No errors were reported in the provided monitoring findings.
last24HoursUsage.conclusion: The 30-day monitoring review showed low memory utilization and throughput below 1 RPS in both environments. Continue monitoring Dashboard response time and overall application performance.

items.title: Resend Email option for failed emails
